question.text: Consider the following compound A . Select the correct statement.

options.text: It is more acidic than <math><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></math>

It is more acidic than <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mn>4</mn></msub></math>

It does not react with <math><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">r</mi></math>

solution.text: It is a strong dibasic acid and stronger than CH3OH
